title: Family Paralegal
description:
A well established High Street law firm is seeking a Family Paralegal to join its Family team in Newbury. This Family Paralegal role offers exposure to a broad range of private family matters, supporting solicitors throughout the full case lifecycle. The Family Paralegal will gain hands-on experience across client care, legal drafting and case preparation. This Family Paralegal opportunity is suited to someone looking to build a long-term career within family law.

The Company?

The successful Family Paralegal will join a respected local law firm with an established Family team advising clients on a wide range of private family matters. The team provides a supportive working environment, ongoing mentoring and direct exposure to client work alongside experienced solicitors.

The Role

As the Family Paralegal you will support fee earners across a varied caseload of family matters.

The role will include:

Assisting with divorce, financial remedy and private children matters
Preparing legal documents, correspondence and court bundles
Conducting legal research and case preparation
Managing case files and maintaining accurate records
Liaising with clients, barristers, courts and third parties
Supporting domestic abuse and cohabitation matters
Assisting with general file administration and case progression
Monitoring deadlines and ensuring matters progress efficiently

The Family Paralegal?

You will have previous family law experience and a genuine interest in developing your career within family law.

The Family Paralegal must have:

Previous experience within a Family Law team
Strong drafting and communication skills
Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities
Professional, empathetic and client focused approach
Strong administrative and case management skills
Good IT and case management system skills
Ability to work effectively within a team

In return ?

25,000 to 28,000 salary
Training and development opportunities
Exposure to a broad range of family law matters
Direct mentoring from experienced Family solicitors
Supportive and collaborative team environment
Long term career progression
Competitive benefits package

If you are a Family Paralegal considering your next career move, please contact Chris van Aurich at Brandon James on (phone number removed) for a confidential discussion.

title: paralegal
description:

If you have the relevant skills and experience and are interested in developing your career within the legal sector, we would welcome your application.

title: Paralegal - Real Estate

Conducting legal research and property-related searches
Managing and maintaining electronic documents, databases and records
Assisting with document reviews, proof-reading and document production
Supporting transaction management and completion processes
Liaising with clients, agents and other third parties
Assisting with billing, time recording and other administrative processes
Supporting business development activities and client events where required

About You

Has a degree (minimum 2:1 preferred)
Has a genuine interest in Real Estate and Commercial Property law
Possesses excellent organisational and communication skills
Has strong attention to detail and a proactive approach
Is confident managing competing priorities and meeting deadlines
Enjoys working collaboratively as part of a team
Demonstrates a commitment to delivering exceptional client service

Why Join Field Seymour Parkes?

Field Seymour Parkes is one of the Thames Valley's leading law firms, recognised for delivering exceptional legal advice to businesses, individuals and organisations.

In return, we offer:

Exposure to high-quality real estate work
Ongoing training and development
A supportive and collaborative culture
Opportunities for career progression

Modern offices in the heart of Reading

This is an excellent opportunity to begin or further your legal career with a respected and forward-thinking firm.

Apply today to join the Real Estate team at Field Seymour Parkes.
